params.title: Secondments
params.description: Employees who work for another organisation for part of their week while staying on the payroll. An active secondment's hours count as taken in planning.
params.note: people-secondment-and-side-activities (2026-09-29): REQ-SEC-001/002. AgendaComposer turns an actief secondment into a secondment entry and AvailabilityService commits hoursPerWeek over the contracted week.

params.title: Secondment
params.note: people-secondment-and-side-activities (2026-09-29): D1. The files widget holds the signed agreement. lifecycleActions mirror the schema: activeren and beeindigen.

params.title: Side activities
params.description: Activities employees do next to their job, and the decision on each. Add one to report your own side activity, or to report that you have none.
params.note: people-secondment-and-side-activities (2026-09-29): REQ-SEC-003. My HR > My side activities is a preset on this page (userId = @me), not a second index. SideActivityListener fills in the employee from the reporter's account and keeps Employee.nevenwerkzaamhedenGemeld in step with the register.

params.title: Side activity
params.note: people-secondment-and-side-activities (2026-09-29): D3. Agree is guarded by NoSelfApprovalGuard, refuse by DecisionReasonGuard (a conflict reason is required, and the employee cannot decide on their own report).
